_rule: Document B sections 4 and 6. Every value comes from a verified source, named below. Nothing is inferred. A missing value is reported, never filled in.

sources.price: ticket_class_prices joined to ticket_classes, Supabase project jlwopomkqeawrxlapwpc, read 28 September 2026. Ringside reads 250000 THB minor, which is 2,500 THB, matching Document A. Document A section 5: if the live booking system ever shows a different verified price, the live system takes precedence and this build stops.
sources.seating_type: ticket_classes.assigned_seating for Ringside is true. Matches Document A's Assigned.
sources.url: No conflict. /rajadamnern-stadium-seating/ringside is the only Ringside child URL anywhere in this repository, and the parent seating page already links to it with the approved anchor Explore Ringside. Checked 28 September 2026.
sources.photographs: Supplied by the owner on 28 September 2026, each with the position it was taken from, in his own words. None of the files can be opened from this environment: static.tildacdn.com is blocked by the network policy.
sources.alt_text: Document A section 8 supplies three approved alt lines. The owner instructed on 28 September 2026 that all six photographs go on the page, which needs six accurate descriptions. His own note on each photograph, in his words, is used verbatim as its alt text. Nothing here was written by this build. The note on 1000033703 contains the typo "I is also next to" and is left exactly as he wrote it.
sources.destinations: Document A section 9. No URL was composed.
sources.shapes: The owner, 28 September 2026: 1000033703 is 1690 x 900 and is a hero-size image for a reason; everything else he supplies is generally 1024 x 1024 and stays square. The overview 1000034569 is wide, measured off his own screen capture at roughly 1.95:1. None of the files can be opened from here.
